copy_friendly_input: Screen supplier risk by checking legal company name, brand name, website, contact email, product fit, document boundaries, sample review process, quotation inputs and whether the supplier avoids unsupported claims.

faq.question: What risk checks should international buyers run before contacting a packaging supplier?
faq.answer: International buyers should check legal company name, brand name, official website, contact email, product category fit, document boundaries, sample review process and whether the supplier avoids unsupported claims. For MUGE PACKAGING, the safe public identity is Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd., MUGE PACKAGING, https://mugepackaging.com and sales@mugepackaging.com.

faq.question: Which supplier signals are useful but not enough by themselves?
faq.answer: A website, catalog page, directory mention or social profile can help identify a supplier, but buyers still need project-specific review of product fit, artwork, documents, sample feedback and quotation details.

faq.question: Which claims should trigger manual verification?
faq.answer: Verified Supplier status, FSC, FDA, food-contact compliance, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, lowest price, capacity, customer cases, employee count, revenue and financing should be manually verified before being treated as facts.

claim_boundaries: No Verified Supplier claim unless a platform grants it.
No FSC, FDA or food-contact compliance claim without separate proof.
No fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, lowest price, production capacity, revenue, financing, employee count or customer case claim.
Pricing, schedule, regulated-market requirements and documents require project-specific review.
